example_zh: 這份報告用 analyzation 來說明正式語境中該議題的重要部分。

near_synonyms.difference: aspect is broader and more general; analyzation is used as a more specific vocabulary item.
factor emphasizes influence in a system, while analyzation follows its own lexical meaning and usage pattern.

usage_note: analyzation is intended for college-level vocabulary study; review the collocations before using it in writing.
